segments.text: Next to interpellate is Representative Karl Legazpi from the majority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Good afternoon po, Mr. Secretary, and to the department and to its attached agencies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Ang amin pong mga katanungan ay nakasentro po sa lalawigan ng Palawan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Dahil po taga-doon po ako at ang amin pong constituencies ay galing po sa Palawan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: So mostly po, just a request on the updates on the development and progress of the active projects there.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: And yung pinaka-primary na issue na nilapit po sa aming tanggapan eh yung RoRo Port ng San Fernando sa El Nido, sa Palawan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: I would just like to get an update po, probably from the PPA, if you have a timeline po on what we can expect from the development.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Kasi po yung port, I believe, was already finished.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Kailangan na lang ng additional development and additional construction po ng mga infrastructure doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: So may we get po an update from the PPA?

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: Thank you po, Your Honor. With the permission of the Secretary po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: Yun pong port natin sa San Fernando, El Nido.

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: Currently po, there is a pending request from the provincial government of Palawan

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: na i-devolve po sa kanila yung operation

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: yung operation ng San Fernando Port, El Nido, together with the Borac Port po in Coron.

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: So we are working on the documentation po for the turnover of those two ports

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: to be managed and operated by the provincial government po ng Palawan.

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: Kaya from PPA's end po, pending that turnover, we will not be scheduling any development po.

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: So ang development po noon will now be on the part of the provincial government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi
segments.text: Wala pong additional support na, sir, from the PPA?

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: Sa ngayon po kasi, Mr. Chair, if we put on the development,

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: we will not be able to devolve that to the provincial government.

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: I think yung request kasi ng provincial government is with urgency also

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: that they want to operate both ports po.

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: So nandoon po tayo ngayon sa sitwasyon na iyon.

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: So ang commitment naman po ng provincial government is that

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago
segments.text: whatever development that is needed, particularly po sa San Fernando,

segments.speaker: PPA General Manager Jay Daniel R. Santiago

segments.speaker: Rep. Karl Fernandez Legazpi

segments.text: Next to interpellate is Representative Indy Oaminal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: To share my concern, I actually discussed this already briefly with the Secretary, but I just want to discuss it further to emphasize the details and to address the said concern.

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: So to Mr. Chair, our Honorable Secretary, has the Department been made aware of the DEPDEV's Northern Mindanao Plan for 2023 to 2028, wherein it is stated there that there is a need to fast-track the completion of the Ozamiz City Airport modernization?

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.

segments.text: President Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos visited Northern Mindanao back in 2024, specifically in Iligan, he referred to the same plan and explicitly stated that the Ozamiz City modernization is one of the priority projects of his administration to be completed in 2028, Mr. Chair.

segments.text: Mr. Chair, hindi naman parang cross-examination dito.

segments.text: Yes or no, can I explain, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: Just laying down some basis, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: And as an item in the DEPDEV's priority plan and as a priority project as stated by the President, I just want to ask, Mr. Chair, Honorable Secretary, how much was funded in the DOTR budget for the Ozamiz City Airport in 2023?

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Can I defer to our implementing unit, at least for the funding?

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: Yes, of course, Mr. Chair, Honorable Secretary.

segments.speaker: DOTr Director Eduardo J. Mangalili
segments.text: Your Honor, sir, for... from DOTR, we don't have allocation in 2023.

segments.speaker: DOTr Director Eduardo J. Mangalili
segments.text: Okay, sir, to further clarify, from 2023 onward, DOTR has no fund for this.

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: So, even though the airport was identified as a priority project from 2023 onwards, but

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: Did I hear that correct, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: Wala pong pondo na-allocate for it sa DOTR budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: So, paano po kaya yan nangyari, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: I have my own theories, but I also want to hear from the department.

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: And I don't mean to point any fingers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: I especially don't want to blame or point the finger at our Honorable Secretary, considering

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: luma na po yung plan na to and he was just recently appointed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: Na may plano na po sa DEPDEV, nabanggit din po ng Pangulo mismo, pero hindi po talaga siya

segments.speaker: Rep. Henry "Indy" F. Oaminal Jr.
segments.text: baga natutukan at napondohan, Mr. Chair, Honorable Secretary.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Could only be two things, Mr. Chair.

segments.text: Yung limited fiscal space po ng gobyerno at yung obligation and utilization rate po ng

segments.text: unless hindi siya shovel-ready na sinasabi, implementation-ready ang mga proyektong to.

segments.text: Pero kahit na ganun pong implementation-ready siya, meron pong dalawang mabigat na rason

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: kung bakit minsan hindi po nabibigyan ng pondo ang isang proyektong to.

segments.text: Ano po yung isa pang rason, Mr. Chair, if I may ask?

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: of isang department o kagawaran po.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: So parang DOTR, hindi ko po sinasabi na mababa ang kanilang at that time.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Maari po yung dalawang yun ang nagiging rason at hindi nabibigyan po ng pondo.

segments.speaker: CAAP Assistant Director General Atty. Roberto Martin S. Buenaventura

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Anyway, so is it the policy of the DOTR in terms of, is construction of all these bikeways, transportation in the metropolis,

segments.text: Is it now the policy of the DOTR?

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Mr. Chair, if I may po. Una po, malaking pasalamat po namin sa Kongreso, sa mga distrito,

segments.text: kasi sila po'y talagang nagbibigay ng pondo pagdating sa active transport po natin.

segments.speaker: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Z. Lopez
segments.text: Para sagutin po kung ito ay polisiya, nakasaad din po sa special provision po natin sa batas, sa GAA,

segments.text: city or munisipyo pagdating sa active transport.

segments.text: Not really a policy, pero ito po kasi sa tingin namin para mas mapabilis ang aming disbursement obligation,

segments.text: If that is the policy or stand of the DOTr,
